children: Insight issued $750 million of 0.875% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including the full exercise of the initial purchasers' option to buy an additional $100 million. The notes mature November 15, 2031, and are convertible under specified conditions at an initial conversion price of approximately $198 per share. The company also entered into capped call transactions intended to limit potential dilution or offset certain cash payments upon conversion, and plans to use remaining offering proceeds to repay debt under its asset-based revolving credit facility.
